# Vendored code

Remote Play client for the core (a loopback session to the console's own Remote Play
server: controller input now, game capture for Go Live later). Each folder keeps its
upstream license file.

| Folder | Upstream | Commit | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chiaki-ng/` | [streetpea/chiaki-ng](https://github.com/streetpea/chiaki-ng) `lib/` | `c8bea2642d0e95402f373af55584a3b98cd89417` | AGPL-3.0-only with an OpenSSL exception (`chiaki-ng/LICENSE`) |
| `nanopb/` | [nanopb/nanopb](https://github.com/nanopb/nanopb) (`pb*.c/h` only) | `cad3c18ef15a663e30e3e43e3a752b66378adec1` | zlib (`nanopb/LICENSE.txt`) |
| `jerasure/` | [streetpea/jerasure](https://github.com/streetpea/jerasure) | `505ccb4bc69eee8d7ea40a6089a056b99671134f` | BSD-3-Clause (`jerasure/COPYING`) |
| `gf-complete/` | [streetpea/gf-complete](https://github.com/streetpea/gf-complete) | `fa54a4670a5705c84abf6c24b92b0cd479625478` | BSD-3-Clause (`gf-complete/COPYING`) |

Because chiaki-ng is AGPL-3.0-only, a core built with it is distributed under
AGPL-3.0-only as a whole.

## Changes to chiaki-ng

Only `lib/` is kept, without the files that need FFmpeg, OpenSSL, curl or JSON-C
(`ffmpegdecoder.c`, `pidecoder.c`, `aia.c`, `aia_openssl.c`, `opus*.c`,
`remote/holepunch.c`). The rest builds against the core's mbedTLS 3.6:

- `src/rpcrypt.c`: `chiaki_rpcrypt_generate_iv` gave HMAC-SHA256 a 16-byte output
  buffer; it writes 32 bytes, which crashed on the console. Now 32.
- `src/chiaki_ecdh.c` (upstream `ecdh.c`, renamed so its object does not clash with
  mbedTLS's): mbedTLS 3 keeps the key fields in `ctx.mbed_ecdh`; the context is set up
  with `mbedtls_ecdh_setup`. Build with `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`.
- `src/gkcrypt.c`: `mbedtls_gcm_starts` takes four arguments in mbedTLS 3.
- `src/thread.c`: the console's libc has no `pthread_clockjoin_np`; non-glibc
  builds use the timed join chiaki already has for Android.
- `src/common.c`: no `chiaki_aia_init` (PSN remote play certificates, needs curl).
- `src/remote/rudp.c`: includes `<sys/socket.h>`.
- `src/chiaki_base64.c`: upstream `base64.c`, renamed (clashes with mbedTLS's).
- `src/ps5_stubs.c`: stand-ins for the PSN holepunch functions a LAN session never calls.
- `include/chiaki/config.h`: generated by upstream CMake; Opus off (the core has its own).
- `gen/takion.pb.{c,h}`: generated from `lib/protobuf/takion.proto` with nanopb's
  generator, committed so builds need no protoc.

## Twemoji 15.1.0 (graphics)

`app/assets/art/emoji.png` packs Twemoji's 72x72 pictures (https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji,
tag v15.1.0), resized to 48 px, for every fully-qualified emoji without a skin tone in Unicode's
emoji-test.txt 15.1; `app/src/discord/emoji_table.inc` lists them. Both come from
`app/tools/bake-emoji.py`. Twemoji graphics are © Twitter, Inc. and other contributors,
licensed under CC-BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Other emoji
(skin tones) load from the same Twemoji release on the CDN at run time.
